marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind west 25 knots diminishing to light this afternoon then
increasing to east 15 after midnight. Wind veering to southeast 20 early
Saturday morning. Snow changing to scattered flurries this morning and ending
near midnight. Scattered flurries Saturday evening. Blowing snow ending near
noon. Visibility as low as 1 mile in blowing snow. Temperatures near minus 4. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
